sections.title: 一、语法选择
sections.instruction: 请通读下面短文,掌握其大意,根据语法和上下文连贯的要求,从每小题所给的三个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Good morning, everyone. We have a new classmate, Alice. Here are two [1] of her family.

In the first photo are her grandparents and parents. The old man wearing a black hat is her grandpa. Next [2] him is her grandma. Alice's father is behind her grandpa. He is [3] and he doesn't like talking much. [4] the woman on his right? She is Alice's mother, Mary. She always [5] stories to Alice at night. Also, she spends some time [6] Alice with her English every day.

You can see Alice's uncle and aunt in the next photo. Who is the boy with a pair of glasses? He is [7] son, Mike. He likes playing the violin and he can play it really [8]. Does Mike have [9] brothers or sisters? No, he doesn't. Where is Alice? She is not in these two photos. She is [10] one that takes photos for them!

questions.translation: 这里有两张她家人的照片。
questions.explanation: 基数词two后接可数名词的复数形式photos。故选A。

questions.translation: 在他旁边的是她的奶奶。
questions.explanation: next to是固定介词短语，意为“在……旁边/紧挨着”。故选C。

questions.translation: 他很安静，不太喜欢说话。
questions.explanation: 系动词is后接形容词作表语，quiet意为“安静的/话少的”。quietly为副词，quietness为名词。故选B。

questions.translation: 在他右边的女士是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据答句“She is Alice's mother, Mary.”可知此处询问人物身份，且句子缺少谓语动词，应用Who is的缩写形式Who's。故选A。

questions.translation: 她总是在晚上给爱丽丝读故事。
questions.explanation: 根据频度副词always可知句子描述经常性动作，用一般现在时；主语She是第三人称单数，谓语动词用reads。故选A。

questions.translation: 而且，她每天花一些时间帮助爱丽丝学英语。
questions.explanation: spend time doing sth.为固定句型，意为“花费时间做某事”，动词用-ing形式helping。故选C。

questions.translation: 他是他们的儿子，迈克。
questions.explanation: 空格后修饰名词son，应用形容词性物主代词their（他们的）。故选B。

questions.translation: 他喜欢拉小提琴，而且他拉得非常好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词play应用副词well，play it really well意为“演奏得真好”。故选A。

questions.translation: 迈克有兄弟姐妹吗？
questions.explanation: 在一般疑问句中，修饰可数名词复数表示“一些/任何”通常用any。故选B。

questions.translation: 她是为他们拍照的那个人！
questions.explanation: 此处特指后面定语从句“that takes photos for them”所修饰的那个人，应用定冠词the。故选C。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Dear Mary,

I'm happy to get your letter. Let me introduce my family to you. I live in Canada with my mum, dad and brother. My mum's name is ①_______. She's tall with long hair. She's a history teacher. She often helps me with my history. My dad is ②_______. He's strong and tall. He works in the City Library and he's happy he can work there because he likes reading. Dad is funny and he often makes us laugh. My brother ③_______ is 12. He has big black eyes. He loves sport. He likes to play ping-pong with me on weekends. So we can play ping-pong well.

This is my happy family. We love each other.

Yours,

Nancy

questions.prompt: 11. Fill in the blanks (填空). Which is right? ( )
options: ① Nancy ② Peter ③ Fred
① Ella ② Peter ③ Fred
① Ella ② Fred ③ Peter
① Fred ② Nancy ③ Peter
questions.translation: 填空。哪一个是正确的？
questions.explanation: 信件由Nancy署名撰写；妈妈是tall with long hair, history teacher（对应Ella）；爸爸是strong and tall, funny, works in City Library（对应Fred）；弟弟12岁，大眼睛爱打乒乓球（对应Peter）。因此顺序为① Ella ② Fred ③ Peter。故选C。

questions.translation: 南希的父亲在一家______工作。
questions.explanation: 根据信中“He works in the City Library”可知南希的父亲在图书馆（library）工作。故选D。

questions.prompt: 13. Why does Nancy write the letter? ( )
options: To talk about their favourite sports.
questions.translation: 南希为什么写这封信？
questions.explanation: 根据信件开头“Let me introduce my family to you.”及结尾“This is my happy family.”可知写信的目的是介绍她的家庭。故选B。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Here is a nice photo. Two boys are in it. The boy on the left is Mike. And Peter is talking to him. Mike is 10 years old and Peter is 3 years older than Mike. They are brothers. Mike and Peter are both students. They are in the same school but in different grades. Peter is in Grade 8 and Mike is in Grade 5.

Peter is active. He has a lot of friends at school. He also likes sports. Tennis is his favourite sport. He has five tennis balls and three tennis rackets (球拍). After school, he often plays tennis with his friends for about half an hour. His dream (梦想) is to be a great tennis player. So he usually spends a lot of time practicing it.

Mike is quiet. Reading is his hobby. After school, he usually goes to the school library to do some reading. He likes books on history. It is his dream to be a history teacher. Sometimes he walks in the park next to the school with some of his friends. <u>It</u> is a good place for them.

They like different things, but they are good brothers. They often help each other.

questions.prompt: 14. How long does Peter often play tennis with his friends? ( )
options: For one and a half hours.
questions.translation: 彼得经常和朋友打多久网球？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“After school, he often plays tennis with his friends for about half an hour.”可知大约半小时。故选C。

questions.prompt: 15. What does the underlined word "<u>It</u>" in Paragraph 3 refer to? ( )
questions.translation: 第三段中画线的单词“It”指代什么？
questions.explanation: 根据前一句“Sometimes he walks in the park next to the school with some of his friends. It is a good place for them.”可知It指代前面提到的公园（the park）。故选D。

questions.prompt: 16. Which is the structure of the passage? (①=Paragraph 1...) ( )
options: ① branching into ② and ③, then converging to ④
① branching into ②, ③, and ④ parallel
① leading to ②, branching to ③ and ④
①, ②, ③ parallel leading to ④
questions.translation: 这篇文章的结构是哪一个？（①=第1段……）
questions.explanation: 第1段总引出两兄弟（总起①）；第2段分述哥哥彼得（②），第3段分述弟弟迈克（③）；第4段总结两兄弟互相帮助（总结④）。属于典型的“总—分—总”结构（①分支为②和③，再汇聚到④）。故选A。

questions.prompt: 17. What's the best title for the passage? ( )
questions.translation: 这篇文章最好的标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文围绕迈克和彼得两兄弟的年龄、年级、性格爱好及梦想展开对比与介绍，因此“Two Brothers”（两兄弟）是最佳标题。故选B。

sections.title: 四、阅读表达
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Everyone has a family. It is the place where life begins and love never ends. In English, "FAMILY" can be "Father and mother, I love you." In Chinese, "家" looks like a house—the "宀" looks like a roof (屋顶) and the "豕" means "pig".

Why is there a "pig" under the "roof"? In old times, many families needed pigs to be their food. No food, no life. So pigs really meant a lot to a family. Now, some Chinese people give "家" a new story. The two strokes (笔画) under the roof are grandparents. They keep the family members together. Other members are under the grandparents. On their right are the parents. They work hard and teach their children. On their left are the children. Brothers and sisters have fun together.

There are so many different families, but in all the families, people love and help each other. "A happy family makes everything fine." What is your happy family like?

questions.translation: 在单词“FAMILY”中，“L”可以代表什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“In English, 'FAMILY' can be 'Father and mother, I love you.'”可知L代表Love。故选B。

questions.prompt: 19. Why did pigs mean a lot to old Chinese families? ( )
options: Because they were pets of families.
Because they were needed as food.
Because they were symbols of good luck.
Because they helped people do farm work.
questions.translation: 为什么在古代中国家庭中猪非常重要？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“In old times, many families needed pigs to be their food. No food, no life. So pigs really meant a lot to a family.”可知因为猪是必需的食物来源。故选B。

questions.prompt: 20. Who often keeps the family members together in a Chinese family? ( )
questions.translation: 在中国家庭中，通常是谁维系着家庭成员团结在一起？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“The two strokes under the roof are grandparents. They keep the family members together.”可知是祖父母（Grandparents）。故选A。

questions.prompt: 21. What does "豕" mean now according to the new story? ( )
options: It still only means a pig.
It means the house and roof.
It represents grandparents, parents and children.
It means good food and wealth.
questions.translation: 根据新的寓意解释，“豕”现在代表什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段关于新故事的解释，“豕”的部分被赋予了新的寓意：两笔代表祖父母，下方右侧为父母，左侧为孩子，即代表了祖父母、父母和孩子共同构成的家庭成员。故选C。

questions.prompt: 22. How do people make a family happy according to the passage? ( )
options: By eating a lot of delicious food.
By loving and helping each other.
By getting a big house with a roof.
questions.translation: 根据短文，人们如何让家庭幸福？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“There are so many different families, but in all the families, people love and help each other. 'A happy family makes everything fine.'”可知是通过互相爱护与互相帮助。故选B。

sections.title: 五、补全对话
sections.instruction: 根据对话内容,从方框内的选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项,其中有两项为多余选项。

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm Alice. I'm new here. [1]

dialogue.speaker: Bob
dialogue.text: Hi, Alice, I'm Bob. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: Bob
dialogue.text: I enjoy playing basketball and reading books.

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! I like drawing and listening to music.

dialogue.speaker: Bob
dialogue.text: [4] Do you have any brothers or sisters?

dialogue.speaker: Alice
dialogue.text: Yes, I have a little brother. He's 7 years old. What about your family?

dialogue.speaker: Bob
dialogue.text: I have a sister. [5] We have a lot of fun together.

options: C. May I know your name?
D. Nice to meet you too, Bob.
E. What color is your schoolbag?
F. Why do you like playing basketball?
G. What do you like doing in your free time?

questions.translation: 我可以知道你的名字吗？
questions.explanation: 前句Alice自我介绍“Hi, I'm Alice. I'm new here.”，后句Bob回答自己的名字“Hi, Alice, I'm Bob.”，可知此处Alice询问对方名字，选项C“May I know your name?”符合语境。故选C。

questions.translation: 也很高兴认识你，鲍勃。
questions.explanation: 上一句Bob说“Nice to meet you.”，礼貌回应为“Nice to meet you too, Bob.”，对应选项D。故选D。

questions.translation: 你在空闲时间喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 下句Bob回答业余爱好“I enjoy playing basketball and reading books.”，可知此处询问对方空闲时间的喜好，对应选项G“What do you like doing in your free time?”。故选G。

questions.translation: 噢，太酷了。
questions.explanation: 上句Alice分享了自己的爱好“I like drawing and listening to music.”，Bob对此表示赞许“Oh, that's cool.”，随后引出关于家庭成员的话题，对应选项A。故选A。

questions.translation: 她在读高中。
questions.explanation: 前句Bob提到“I have a sister.”，选项B“She's in high school.”承接介绍姐姐/妹妹的情况，代词She与sister一致。故选B。
